name: Lorosuchus
sum: Lorosuchus is a sebecid crocodyliform from the Paleocene Río Loro Formation of north-western Argentina.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: PVL 6219, a nearly complete skull articulated with the lower jaws and fragmentary postcranial remains (Río Loro Formation, Tucumán Province).
biology: The species name refers to the ornamentation of the skull roof, which resembles that of the unrelated Proterochampsa; the sources consulted give no direct evidence of diet.
author: Pol and Powell 2011

sources.text: D. Pol and J. E. Powell. 2011. A new sebecid mesoeucrocodylian from the Rio Loro Formation (Palaeocene) of north-western Argentina. Zoological Journal of the Linnean Society 163:S7-S36
